name: Suzunone Seven! -Sweet Lovers' Concerto-
source:
Suzunone Seven! -Sweet Lovers' Concerto- contains four after story routes for the main characters from the original game, as well as four new routes for the side characters. Includes the common route from the original game.

-Yuzuri's Story-
Two months have passed since the trial. I am now living a peaceful life with my friends. Just one week before the graduation ceremony, Yuzuri visits Yukimura's house to write a speech in reply given during the ceremony....

[From ErogeShop]
